{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./alae_imagenet.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   --nodes=32            -> -N 32
#   --ntasks-per-node=1   -> -n 32
#   --cpus-per-task=128   -> -c 128
#   --time=06:00:00       -> -t 6h
#   --gres=gpu:1          -> -g 32 (1 GPU per node)
#   --output=out          -> -o output=out
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 32 -n 32 -c 128 -g 32 -t 6h -o output=out --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm --error=err not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: stderr will follow Flux defaults unless configured at submission.

  # NOTE: Slurm --partition=gpus not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible GPU resources; you are not forcing the gpus partition.

  source ~/pyenv
  ml purge
  ml Stages/Devel-2019a
  ml GCC/8.3.0
  ml ParaStationMPI/5.4.4-1
  ml CUDA/10.1.105
  ml NCCL/2.4.6-1-CUDA-10.1.105
  ml cuDNN/7.5.1.10-CUDA-10.1.105

  export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
  export NCCL_IB_CUDA_SUPPORT=0
  export NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1

  # Slurm used: srun python ...
  flux run -n 32 -c 128 -g 32 python train_alae.py --config-file configs/imagenet.yaml
fi
"
}

issues: This is a self-submitting pattern: it will only work if `flux batch` can connect to a Flux broker from where the script is executed (inside a Flux instance or via a site-provided submission endpoint).

Portability: requesting GPUs with `-g 32` requires the Flux instance to be configured with GPU/generic resources and to have at least 32 GPUs available; otherwise the job may be rejected or remain unschedulable.

The request `-N 32 -n 32 -c 128 -g 32` is extremely large (4096 CPU cores if interpreted as 128 cores per task across 32 tasks); it may violate site policy/limits or be infeasible on many Flux deployments (resource feasibility concern).
